0x001A38.en: 「Learn firsthand/　what happens to those who stand in my way!」

0x001A88.en: 「Curse your luck that I'm your foe.」

0x001B18.en: 「My name is Ahmed Hammoudi!/ Carve it into your mind!」

0x001B71.en: 「There's much to gain on the edge of life and death...」

0x001BEB.en: 「First time since the royal match... no holding back, Masaki./ Show me your full power!」

0x001C50.en: 「We're on opposite sides now, Masaki./ But isn't this kind of freedom/ just like a Wind Elemental Lord's pilot?」

0x001CDD.en: 「What's right and what's wrong.../ isn't it arrogant to decide that on your own?/ Tytti.」

0x001D64.en: 「So the Gaddess deems me a worthy foe./ But aren't there/ other enemies you should fight?」

0x001DEB.en: 「I walk the path I believe in./ Just as you do, Yang Long.」

0x001E50.en: 「Your cause is naive and small-minded./ Someday it'll cost you dearly!」

0x001EC1.en: 「Lune, was it?/ How about learning some modesty?」

0x001F23.en: 「Hmph.../ You still can't master Zamzeed,/ little girl!」

0x001F89.en: 「Chosen by Zamzeed or not,/ you're still unworthy of it!」

0x001FE8.en: 「Oh, there you are, Gennacy./ Nearly overlooked you.」

0x002041.en: 「Piloting the Diablo now, Presia.../ That makes you a real pilot. No mercy!」

0x0020C1.en: 「Choosing to march into battle, Presia./ The path of carnage - just like your father.」

0x00212F.en: 「Even for you, Lady Xenia, this is war./ Prepare yourself.」

0x002185.en: 「This is the path you chose./ Just don't regret it, Zash.」

0x0021DB.en: 「Shu... a fine opponent indeed./ I'll show you Solgady's mobility!」

0x00224F.en: 「Hehe... I feel a fearsome Prana...!/ A foe this strong/ is a rare sight indeed.」

0x0022EE.en: 「Good grief.../ Fighting you goes against my grain,/ Saphine.」

0x002351.en: 「I've no time to toy with you./ Let's end this quick, Saphine.」

0x0023BF.en: 「Oh my, such unseemly conduct/ for a princess.」

0x002409.en: 「A battlefield isn't so kind/ that royal games work here.」

0x00246E.en: 「Summoned to La Gias, machine and all...」

0x0024B1.en: 「Bad luck for you,/ summoned amid this turmoil.」

0x0024FE.en: 「Heh.../ How far will surface war logic get you?」

0x002582.en: 「Fighting the strong - that's my only wish!」

0x0025BC.en: 「Yes... close enough that we both bleed./ Now this is a battlefield!」

0x002612.en: 「Facing a mighty foe/ is what makes the fight worthwhile.」

0x0027DD.en: 「Guh... blast it./ Took too much damage...」

0x0029E8.en: 「A-as expected,/ Granveil's power is off the charts...!」

0x002A7E.en: 「Mmngh!!/ So you're worthy of Zamzeed after all.」

0x002AD7.en: 「N-not bad, Gennacy.../ Cornering me this far...」

0x002B39.en: 「Nnngh!!/ T-truly the Sword Emperor's daughter... deadly.」

0x002C5D.en: 「I didn't underestimate you, but.../ well done, Saphine.」

0x002CB3.en: 「T-to think Princess Monica/ could push me this far...」

0x002DAC.en: 「A hit. But I won't fall so easily!」

0x002DEC.en: 「Ngh, so what! I'm just getting started!」

0x002E54.en: 「Ho, not bad. That's more like it.」

0x002E94.en: 「Heh... So you're getting serious now, Masaki.」

0x002F0B.en: 「Heh heh.../ Yes, good! That's more like it!」

0x002F58.en: 「You've learned to handle Zamzeed a bit, /  little girl?」

0x002FE2.en: 「Hmph... As expected of Zeoruot's /  daughter, I'll say.」

0x00308B.en: 「Hm... I see./ So General Kirkus's son /  isn't riding on his name alone.」

0x003103.en: 「As expected, Shu!/ This is what makes it fun!」

0x003150.en: 「Honestly.../ I'd rather never cross blades with you again.」

0x0031A3.en: 「Hmph.../ To think Princess Monica's come this far.」

0x003259.en: 「Don't tell me you think /  that's enough to take down /  Solgady!」

0x0032E4.en: 「Hmph, underestimated.../ Trying to take me on with that much!」

0x00343F.en: 「Hmph, /  is this all Granveil's vaunted power can do?」

0x0034F4.en: 「No place for a child here, Presia!」

0x00355C.en: 「Hmph, I'll give you credit for landing that, /  Zashford.」

0x0035AF.en: 「What's wrong?/ This can't be your best, Shu?」

0x003652.en: 「Don't expect your foe /  to hold still forever.」

0x003766.en: 「I won't lose in speed, Yang Long.」

0x003797.en: 「Hmph, with skill like that, Ricardo won't rest easy.」

0x0037DA.en: 「Lady Xenia, the battlefield is no game.」

0x003845.en: 「Hmph... Even the Granzon /  is no threat if it can't land a hit!」

0x0038D5.en: 「I don't have time to humor /  a princess at play.」

0x003963.en: 「Just as I thought... I knew you'd try that.」

0x003A46.en: 「Hm, out of range... So you do think ahead.」

0x003AB4.en: 「An opening on the field means death./ Remember that!」

0x003B60.en: 「Right, leave the finishing blow to me!」

0x003E46.en: 「All who bar my path... I'll cut down!」
